heading: When an AI Agent Stops, Who Finishes the Work?
deck: A stopped run is not necessarily a finished business task.
alt_text: A central AI agent flow leads to four distinct business outcomes: verified completion, a controlled stop, confirmed partial execution and unknown external state. Each has a different executive response. Governance covers authorization before execution, controls during tool use and verification and recovery afterward.
